artworks.title: The Goose Shop
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a market scene with poultry and game. The scene shows a market stall with various game animals, such as birds, displayed. The drawing includes hanging animal carcasses and crates containing poultry. Details of the building, such as wooden and brick textures, add to the realism. Fine lines typical of etching techniques create depth and detail, illustrating the wares, architecture, and environment of the market.

artworks.title: A North-East View from Sandham Cottage, Isle of Wight
artworks.description: The image shows a north-east view with rolling hills extending into the distance. The horizon line is in the upper section of the image, meeting a cliff with a visible face toward the sea. The artwork displays meticulous brushstrokes or etching, detailing textures in the clouds and landscape. A woman is depicted standing on a terrace looking out over the landscape, with a dog nearby. To the left, a building with columns and a detailed door is visible. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and sepia. In the distance, patchwork fields, trees, and a coastal view are depicted.

artworks.title: Royal Progeny of King James
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a royal family tree, displaying a genealogical chart associated with King James. It includes various historical figures linked by illustrations of roses and shields. Circular portraits of the figures are connected by stylized vines or branches within oval frames. Each figure's name and title are inscribed below their likeness, accompanied by coats of arms and heraldic symbols. The drawing features intricate details and precise line work showing royal regalia and clothing, evoking authority and historical significance.

artworks.title: A Cottage on Fire
artworks.artist: Charles Turner (printmaker); Mrs. Yates (artist after); Edward Orme (publisher)
artworks.medium: color mezzotint with hand coloring and varnish on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cottage on fire, with a group of figures trying to fetch water nearby. The brushstrokes are dynamic, emphasizing the fire's movement. The color palette contrasts dark blues and blacks with vibrant oranges and reds. Other structures in the distance hint at a perilous situation.

artworks.title: Genova dal Giardino Durazzo al Zerbino (Genoa from the Giardino Durazzo al Zerbino)
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine colle on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woodland area with a garden and a view of a distant cityscape. The horizon is visible in the upper third of the image, showing the urban landscape merging with a lightly sketched sky. The brushstroke technique is detailed, focusing on the leaves, bark of trees, and architectural elements in the distance. The color palette is monochrome with various shades of gray, giving the scene a classic quality. A reflective pond is seen surrounded by dense foliage and tree trunks. In the distance, the cityscape features domes, towers, and other urban structures against the sky.

artworks.title: Study for a Monument
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink over graphite
artworks.description: The image is a sketch drawing that shows two figures. The first figure is prominently displayed in the foreground, sitting inside what appears to be a shallow basin or dish. This person is positioned with their knees drawn up and one hand resting on their face. The second figure is presented standing to the right of the seated person.

artworks.title: King John [right side]
artworks.medium: pen and brown-black ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length illustrations of two figures, each on one half of the page. On the left side, the figure labeled "Henricus IV" is standing in a forward-facing position but with his head turned to the left. He is depicted with long, wavy hair and a beard. He is wearing a crown and a detailed robe with intricate designs. His left hand holds an orb topped with a cross, while his right hand rests on a long scepter. On the right side, the figure labeled "Johannes" stands facing forward, with his head slightly to the right, wearing a crown similar to the other figure. He is adorned in ornate armor with detailed patterns and holds a sword in his right hand and a small orb with a cross in his left hand. Both figures are positioned beneath a heraldic shield featuring three lions. The background of the image is filled with faint text or a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Alphonse Hirsch
artworks.medium: drypoint and aquatint on thick wove paper [restrike]
artworks.description: The image depicts the head and upper torso of a person in a side profile. The individual has closed eyes, a prominent nose, full beard, short, slightly disheveled hair, and is wearing textured clothing. The background is plain with a light, textured monochrome appearance, emphasizing the figure in the foreground. The style of the image resembles an etching or charcoal sketch, giving it a vintage appearance.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies
artworks.medium: graphite//on back of 1798 Royal Academy exhibition announcement
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple abstract and loosely sketched human figures. The drawing features several small, faint pencil sketches arranged across a plain background. The figures are simplified and primarily composed of soft, curved lines, suggesting dynamic and flowing movement. Some of the figures appear to be grouped closely together. The sketches lack specific detail, but the overall composition implies a sense of harmony and connectivity between the figures, showcasing an interest in human form and expression.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image features a pencil sketch of a person's face with a focus on their facial features from just below the chin upwards. The person is facing forward, revealing their eyes, nose, lips, and hair. The hair is partially visible under a head covering, possibly a scarf or turban. The sketch has a plain background.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies
artworks.description: This is a drawing of rough sketches with multiple dynamic figures and forms. The image contains lightly drawn outlines and sketches scattered across the canvas. The figures seem to be positioned in various actions or gestures, indicating movement. The sketches are faint, with the use of light pencil or graphite on what appears to be plain paper. The drawing captures a sense of experimentation with shapes and expressions without definite details.

artworks.title: Sketch for a Gothic Monument (the Simcoe Monument?)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in architectural niches. The drawing features a simple sketch of a decorative architectural element resembling an arched frame. Within the two niches on either side, there are faint outlines resembling draped figures. The arch itself has a series of curves. The drawing lacks detailed features, focusing on the general composition and layout. The lines are light, suggesting a preparatory stage or a rough sketch for further work. The medium appears to be graphite or pencil on paper, providing a soft appearance to the drawing.

artworks.title: Studies of a Male Figure
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch with six different figures in various poses. The bodies are fully shown with minimal facial detail, focusing on body posture. The figures are unclothed and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies
artworks.description: The image has a pencil sketch of a figure in the foreground lying down with one arm propped up. There are other rudimentary sketches of figures and shapes in the background. The background is a plain paper surface.

artworks.title: Three Inscription Fields
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The image shows vertical lines resembling columns supporting a rectangular shape above, with a circular form in the middle.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies
artworks.medium: graphite//brown wash uL corner unrelated to composition
artworks.description: Multiple small sketches are depicted in various scenes. The sketches are quick and light pencil drawings showing different narrative moments. Each sketch captures dynamic interactions, with figures engaged in storytelling, consolation, and contemplation. The figures are rendered with minimal detail, focusing on movement and posture. The page shows overlapping scenes, giving the impression of an artist experimenting with composition and themes on the same canvas. The drawing appears to be an exercise in preliminary studies or a storyboard for a more detailed work.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various overlapping sketches of dynamic figures. The drawing features multiple lightly sketched figures, some appearing to be in motion, with limbs extended and torsos bent. The sketches are executed with quick, fluid pencil strokes, suggesting a study of movement or action, possibly capturing different poses and perspectives. They are scattered across the paper without a background. The upper portion appears to have a cut or torn edge, and some brown stains are visible on the paper.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies
artworks.description: This is a drawing of faintly sketched figures on a textured surface. The drawing features two simple outlines. The figures are presented in an impressionistic style, lacking solid definition and appearing more as suggestions rather than precise depictions. The paper is marked with small specks.

artworks.title: Three Reclining Female Figures
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of three figures in a reclined position. The figures are drawn with simple outline features, without distinct facial features or detailed clothing. The background is a plain, slightly textured paper with scattered spots and discolorations, suggesting age. The edges of the paper are slightly torn.

artworks.title: Structure with Figures in Asian Dress (Illustration for “The Casket”?)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural elements featuring statues and structures. It contains light pencil sketches on paper, depicting figure-like sculptures within architectural frames or niches. The left side shows a structure with columns and niches, each containing a sketchy figure. The figures are roughly detailed, resembling classical or renaissance statues with draped garments. There are scattered sketch marks suggesting additional elements in the background. The drawing is rudimentary and appears to be a preparatory sketch or study. The paper's texture and torn edges contribute to an aged quality.

artworks.title: Designs for Monuments [recto and verso]
artworks.medium: graphite//compositionally unrelated ink and wash, recto and verso
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural designs or ornamental frames. The image displays sketches of several detailed architectural or ornamental frame designs, each adorned with elements like scrolls, arches, and intricate reliefs. The designs are arranged on the paper, with construction lines and annotations indicating a work-in-progress or a study for future execution. The outlines are done with light pencil strokes, showing an unfinished or exploratory phase of design.

artworks.title: Studies of Seated and Reclining Figures
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch made with faint pencil lines on a light-colored, textured sheet of paper. The sketch consists of multiple incomplete and loosely drawn human figures scattered across the surface. These figures are outlined with minimal detail, focusing primarily on basic shapes and lines to suggest heads, torsos, and limbs, with no distinct facial features or hairstyles. Some figures appear to be seated or reclining, while others are standing, but the positions are only roughly indicated due to the sketch's simplistic nature. The clothing is not detailed enough to describe, and the background is plain, only showing more of the paper's texture with some scattered brownish spots. No additional objects, jewelry, or elements are clearly visible around the figures.

artworks.title: Study for "The Fury of Athamas"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in motion. The drawing is a simple, rough sketch that suggests two figures entwined in action. The lines are light and incomplete, suggesting movement. The forms are abstracted, with a cloak or drapery hinted at on one of the figures. The central figure is in mid-action, leaning forward with another figure slightly behind, engaged in a dynamic interaction. The minimalist nature of the sketch highlights the fluidity and energy within the composition.

artworks.title: Sphinx with Reclining Figures in Foreground
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an individual from the chest up. The person is depicted facing forward with almond-shaped eyes and a simple line for the mouth. They wear a head covering that falls over the shoulders. The sketch suggests a robe or similar garment. There is no jewelry or objects in their hands. Below the figure, there is an outline of an object or platform. To the side, there is a faint drawing of a creature or artifact with defined features like a beak or long snout. The background is empty with aged paper as the surface.
